title: Panda Adventure player configuration
description: Authoritative config for S1 player traversal (gADR-0000: JSON is the single source of truth). Converted to data/generated/player_config.tres (a PlayerConfig Resource) by scripts/build_config.py. The platform blockout migrated OUT to level_config.json in S9 (gADR-0010) — this file is player-scoped only, and the player_size box migrated OUT to scale_spec.json (gADR-0013) — the builder composes it back into the derived Resource.

player_color.description: Player block color as RGBA, each component in 0..1.

player_start.description: Player spawn position (x, y) in pixels — the CharacterBody2D origin.

move_speed.description: Horizontal move speed in px/s; strictly positive.

jump_velocity.description: Jump impulse in px/s; strictly negative (upward, Godot +Y-down).

gravity.description: Downward gravity in px/s^2; strictly positive.

max_fall_speed.description: Terminal fall speed cap in px/s; strictly positive.

camera_smoothing_speed.description: Follow-camera position smoothing speed; strictly positive.

landing_squash.description: Player block scale (x, y) at the moment of landing — the squash-stretch pose the tween recovers from; each strictly positive.

landing_tween_duration.description: Seconds for the landing squash to recover to normal scale; strictly positive.
